headline: Finnish and European creative industries are split in late November 2026. Hit-driven games (Remedy) and international design brands (Marimekko) are growing. Smaller studios keep closing, textile innovation is still pre-revenue, and the Digital Fairness Act proposal adds regulatory risk for games.

signals.title: No 2027 Business Finland Research to Business call yet
signals.detail: Call 2/2026 closed on 2026-09-16, with decisions expected in January 2027. Call 1/2026 opened on 2025-12-01, so a new call opening in the next weeks is plausible (inference).

signals.title: Remedy's CONTROL Resonant launch drives Q3 revenue
signals.detail: Q3 revenue rose 226% to €39.6 m, and the game sold one million copies in three weeks.

signals.title: Playnest closes; Rovio cuts about 20 jobs at Ruby Games; Supercell paid €216.4 m Finnish corporate tax for 2025
signals.detail: Same Neogames weekly roundup: Silent But Deadly, a new studio founded by Supercell and Remedy veterans, is backed by Sisu Game Ventures. Supercell joined a $5M pre-seed round for Anorak (generative-video formats), co-led by Play Ventures and Backed VC.

signals.title: Commission proposes Digital Fairness Act
signals.detail: The proposal was adopted on 2026-11-11. It targets in-game currencies, gambling-like features for minors and dark patterns, with fines of up to 6% of turnover. Neogames warns it may threaten the Finnish industry. Parliament and Council negotiations are next, and no application date has been set.

signals.title: Neogames: Digital Fairness Act threatens Finnish and European game industry
signals.detail: The Finnish games association reads the proposal as banning in-game purchases by under-18s, requiring a euro value to be shown for every in-game currency use, and banning loosely defined pay-to-win and pay-to-progress mechanics. Law-firm and press readings suggest the published text is narrower: in-game currency is off by default for minors, while paid loot boxes for minors are banned.

signals.title: Spinnova signs non-binding LOI with Outlast
signals.detail: The LOI covers developing Spinnova fibre for insulation and temperature regulation. It is non-binding. A Tearfil acquisition LOI from 2026-09-17 is also pending, with completion targeted for Q1 2027.

signals.title: EIC sets aside €1.8 bn for deep tech in 2027
signals.detail: The EIC Accelerator 2027 has cut-offs on 20 January, 17 March, 1 September and 4 November 2027. This is a route for deep-tech spin-offs, including materials and media technology.

signals.title: Spinnova signs letter of intent with Outlast Technologies
signals.detail: Non-binding LOI to develop Spinnova fibre for insulation and temperature regulation. Spinnova's Woodspin demo factory is in trial runs, with larger-scale production targeted to restart during 2026, depending on trial results.

signals.title: Marimekko Q3: net sales up 3%, international sales up 16%, Finland down 9%
signals.detail: Q3 net sales were €52.1 m and comparable operating profit €13.0 m (25.0% margin). January–September net sales were €137.5 m with comparable operating profit of €23.4 m. Guidance is unchanged (growth on 2025's €189.6 m, margin about 16–19%), but Finnish sales are now expected to decline in 2026.

signals.title: Aalto ranks third in Europe for university spinout funding
signals.detail: Over €500 m raised in H1 2026, mostly by ICEYE. Aalto had eight research spinouts in 2026 and targets 20 a year. The new Aalto Innovation unit now covers commercialisation.

signals.title: Creative Europe 2027 calls open
signals.detail: Creative Innovation Lab (deadline 2027-04-22) and media literacy (deadline 2027-01-20) opened on 2026-10-22.

signals.title: CREA news and media calls open
signals.detail: CREA calls on journalism partnerships, media literacy and media freedom open, with deadlines from 2027-01-20 to 2027-02-04.

signals.title: Ubisoft proposes closing RedLynx (Finland)
signals.detail: The proposal affects up to 52 positions and is subject to Finnish change negotiations. Re-checked on 2026-11-25: no final outcome has been published.

signals.title: Horizon call on textile circularity opens (Textiles for the Future)
signals.detail: HORIZON-CL4-2027-01-MAT-PROD-08 is an Innovation Action call on advanced processing and manufacturing for textile circularity, due 2027-02-02.

signals.title: Q3 2026 gaming deal flow concentrated in AI and dev tools
signals.detail: Reported M&A of $2.4 bn over 45 deals and $1.6 bn+ over 106 funding rounds, mostly to AI and tools. Secondary source, not verified against Drake Star.

signals.title: Textile EPR fact sheet published; national transposition ahead
signals.detail: The revised Waste Framework Directive entered into force on 2025-10-16. Member states must transpose it by June 2027, and schemes are due by April 2028 (sources differ on the exact dates). Brands will pay eco-modulated fees based on durability and recyclability.

companies.name: Supercell
companies.what: Mobile games giant. It paid €216.4 m in Finnish corporate income tax for 2025, and Supercell Investments backs early-stage studios.

companies.name: Remedy Entertainment
companies.what: Listed AAA studio. CONTROL Resonant launched in Q3 2026, and January–September revenue was €62.9 m.

companies.name: Marimekko
companies.what: Design and fashion brand with growth led by international sales.

companies.name: Spinnova
companies.what: Wood-based textile fibre. Pre-commercial, with an operating loss of €6.9 m in H1 2026, and several non-binding LOIs.

companies.name: Infinited Fiber Company
companies.what: Textile-to-textile recycled fibre. Kemi plant permit is under appeal, and commercial deliveries have not started.

companies.name: Ioncell Oy
companies.what: Cellulose fibre technology from Aalto and the University of Helsinki, with Aalto as a founding partner.

companies.name: Woamy Oy
companies.what: Aalto spin-off making cellulose biofoam for packaging, insoles and building panels. €1 m seed round in 2023.

companies.name: Metacore
companies.what: Mobile games studio that cut 159 jobs in 2026, an example of the tight funding climate.

companies.name: Ubisoft RedLynx
companies.what: Trials studio; Ubisoft has proposed closing it (up to 52 positions).

companies.name: Lenzing
companies.what: Fibre producer and industry partner in Aalto's MELANGE project.
